description_en: Constructed west of Bāghabhairava Mandira (KIR0004), Nāsaḥdyaḥ Capāḥ is a two-floored modern building with its terrace covered by corrugated tin sheets. It used to be a two-storied building with aphalcāon the ground floor andjhĩgaṭītile roof on top.The east-facing Capāḥ has the ground floor closed with metal grille works but is still left empty for performing devotional songs (bhajana). The upper floor and the covered terrace are used for hosting programs and feasts.It is unclear when the Capāḥ was initially constructed. It is possible that it was constructed around the same time the temple of Bāghabhairava was constructed forbhajanaperformances. The photos taken byJohn C. Huntingtonin 1970 CE andNiels Gutschowin 1990 CE suggest that there used to be two rest houses. Two buildings are clearly visible in the place where Nāsaḥdyaḥ Capāḥ now stands. The two rest houses were dismantled and rebuilt in 1997 CE (VS 2054) out of the fund collected from a grand fire oblation program. The northern side of the Capāḥ’s ground floor contains a stone statue of Lord Rāma established in 1961 CE (VS 2018). On the southern side, one can see a metal statue of Lord Kṛṣṇa, which was established by Śerabahādura Maharjana from Kirtipur. Although the year of its establishment is not mentioned in the inscription, locals say that it was established c. 1976 CE.Devotional songs are performed here in the mornings and evenings every day. Locals use the space upstairs for hosting feasts and other cultural programs.
description_ne: कीर्तिपुरको बाघभैरव मन्दिर (KIR0004) को पश्चिममा नासःद्यः रहेको छ । त्यही नासःद्यःको ठिक अगाडि रहेको भवन नै नासःद्यः चपाः हो ।बाघभैरव परिसरको उत्तर-पश्चिम कुनामा बनेको पूर्वाभिमुख यस चपाः अहिले दुई तले आधुनिक भवनमा परिवर्तन भैसकेको छ । भुइँ तला भजन गायनका लागि खाली छोडिए पनि फलामे ग्रीलले बन्द गरिएको छ । माथिल्लो तलामा भोज लगायत अन्य कार्यक्रम गर्नका लागि कोठा बनाइएको छ । भवनको छतमा पनि भोज गर्न र बस्न मिल्ने गरी जस्ताको छाना राखिएको छ ।भजन कक्षमा प्रवेश गर्न दुईवटा ढोका रहेका छन् । भजन कक्षको उत्तरी भागमा ढुंगाको भगवान रामको मूर्ति र दक्षिणमा धातुको कृष्ण मूर्ति स्थापना गरिएका छन् । भगवान रामको मूर्ति विसं २०१८ (सन् १९६१) मा स्थापना भएको कुरा मूर्तिको पेटीमा कुदिएको अभिलेखबाट थाहा हुन्छ । धातुको कृष्ण मूर्ति कीर्तिपुरका शेरबहादुर महर्जनले स्थापना गरेका हुन् । मिति कुँदिएको नदेखिए पनि एक स्थानीयका अनुसार उक्त मूर्ति विसं २०३३-३४ साल (सन् १९७६) तिर राखिएको हो ।यस चपाःको निर्माण कहिले र कसले गरेको भन्ने अभिलेख प्राप्त नभएपनि बाघभैरव मन्दिर बनाइएको समयमा नै भजन गर्न निर्माण भएको हुनसक्छ । सन् १९७० सालमाJohn C. Huntingtonले र सन् १९९० माNiels Gutschowले खिचेका फोटोहरूमा झिंगटीको छाना भएका दुई सतः शैलीका संरचनाहरू प्रष्ट देख्न सकिन्छ । ती दुबै सतःलाई पुनर्निर्माणका क्रममा एउटै भवन बनाइएको देखिन्छ । यहाँ प्राप्त अभिलेख अनुसार विसं २०५४ साल (सन् १९९७) मा श्रीमद् भागवत् महायज्ञ गरी उठेको आर्थिक सहयोगबाट यसको पुनर्निर्माण गरिएको थियो ।यहाँ दैनिक बिहान र साँझ दुई पटक भजन गरिन्छ । यस बाहेक स्थानीयको भोजभतेर तथा विविध सांस्कृतिक कार्यक्रमहरू पनि माथिल्लो तलामा हुने गर्दछ । बाघभैरव गुठी व्यवस्थापन समितिले यहाँ हुने विविध कृयाकलापहरूको व्यवस्थापन गर्दै आइरहेको छ (Samiti chairman, Maharjana, male, age 45) ।

historical_events.event_description: The statue of Rāma was installed inside the Capāḥ.

historical_events.event_name: Collection of donations for bhajana performances
historical_events.event_description: Donations were collected from devotees to supportbhajanaperformances at the Capāḥ. The amount hence collected was deposited to a financial institution with 70% of its interest to be used for renovations and refurbishments and the remaining 30% to be added to the principal amount.

historical_events.event_name: Raising funds to continue the procession of Bāghabhairava
historical_events.event_description: Funds were raised to support the annual procession of Bāghabhairava observed on the 10thof the dark fortnight of Bhādra.
Dalūlamps were installed around the Bāghabhairava temple on the occasion of the 42ndbirthday of the late King Birendra. The inscription is not related to the Capāḥ but is installed in it.
The Capāḥ was renovated with the funds collected from a grand fire oblation together with a sermon delivery program.
The clay statue of Bāghabhairava was renovated.
Nepāla Nandana Siṃha Pradhāna, head of the Munsī clan, donated NRs. 1 million to set up a non-expendable fund to financially support the annual procession of the Bāghabhairava.
Śera Bahādur Maharjana of Kritipur installed the metal statue of Kṛṣṇa inside the building.
